name: Suwayomi
description: Suwayomi is a free and open source manga reader server that runs extensions built for Mihon/Tachiyomi. It ships a web UI for browsing, reading, downloading and tracking manga, and syncs reading progress across devices.

notes.text: Authentication is off by default. Enable it under Settings > Server in the web UI, or set authMode in /opt/suwayomi_data/server.conf.
